import numpy as np

def fit(rm, rs):
    rm = np.array(rm, dtype=float)
    y = np.array(rs, dtype=float)
    A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(rm)), rm])
    xhat = np.linalg.solve(A.T @ A, A.T @ y)
    return xhat

screens.title: Covariance over variance
screens.prose: The slope formula from the last lesson is $$\hat\beta = \frac{\sum (x_i - \bar x)(y_i - \bar y)}{\sum (x_i - \bar x)^2} = \frac{\mathrm{Cov}(r_s, r_m)}{\mathrm{Var}(r_m)},$$ since both sums share the same divisor. Compute it from centred arrays.

widget.solution:
import numpy as np

def beta_cov(rm, rs):
    x = np.array(rm, dtype=float)
    y = np.array(rs, dtype=float)
    dx = x - x.mean()
    dy = y - y.mean()
    return (dx @ dy) / (dx @ dx)

widget.solution:
import numpy as np

def r_squared(rm, rs):
    x = np.array(rm, dtype=float)
    y = np.array(rs, dtype=float)
    A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x])
    xhat = np.linalg.solve(A.T @ A, A.T @ y)
    resid = y - A @ xhat
    dy = y - y.mean()
    return 1 - (resid @ resid) / (dy @ dy)

widget.solution:
import numpy as np

def two_betas(rm, rs1, rs2):
    x = np.array(rm, dtype=float)
    A = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(x)), x])
    Y = np.column_stack([rs1, rs2])
    X = np.linalg.solve(A.T @ A, A.T @ Y)
    return X[1]
